next_cycle.title: Backend: move POST /reset-password out of guest middleware group
next_cycle.prompt:
ONE-LINE FIX (move a route declaration). Nothing more.

The PR2 backend branch `feature/auth-p2-backend` has a design bug in `routes/web.php`: the `Route::post('/reset-password', ...)` line is INSIDE the `Route::middleware('guest')->group()` block, but `NewPasswordController::store()` calls `Auth::login()` on success. On a single-use-token replay, the `RedirectIfAuthenticated` middleware kicks in BEFORE the controller's `InvalidResetTokenException` check runs and sends the second POST to `/dashboard` instead of throwing.

## The fix

In `routes/web.php`:
- MOVE the `Route::post('/reset-password', [NewPasswordController::class, 'store'])->name('password.update');` line OUT of the `Route::middleware('guest')->group(function () { ... })` block.
- Place it at the bottom of the file (or in its own `Route::middleware('web')->...` sibling), keeping the existing `web` middleware group (which gives sessions, CSRF, cookies).
- LEAVE `Route::get('/reset-password/{token}', ...)` INSIDE the guest group — a logged-in user who lands on the form should still be bounced to /login (current behavior; matches the design doc's `password.reset` route name).

Net diff: one route declaration moves from inside `Route::middleware('guest')->group(...)` to outside it. ~3 lines of context (move the line + add a blank-line separator if needed). No other files touched.

## Workflow

1. Use the existing worktree at `/tmp/solar-auth-p2-backend` (already has real vendor, the worktree-pitfall workaround in place, and the prior Str fix at `06c4ffd`).
2. Apply the move in `routes/web.php`.
3. Verify locally: `/opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.4/bin/php artisan route:list | grep password` should show all 4 password routes (`password.request`, `password.email`, `password.reset`, `password.update`) and ONLY `password.update` should NOT be listed under the `web,guest` middleware group — it should be just `web`.
4. Run baseline to ensure no regression: `/opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.4/bin/php artisan test --filter='AuthTest|EmailVerificationTest'` — must be 22/22 green.
5. Commit on `feature/auth-p2-backend`:
   - `git config user.name "Henrique Della Manna"`
   - `git config user.email "henrique.dellamanna@gmail.com"`
   - `git add routes/web.php`
   - `git commit -m "fix(auth): move POST /reset-password out of guest group so single-use replay test works"`
   - `git push origin feature/auth-p2-backend`
6. Write `deliverable.md` in the worktree root with: the route:list output, the diff hunk, the test result line, the push confirmation.

Do NOT touch any other file. Do NOT refactor. Do NOT add tests. ONE route move.
